site.description: the forum's host name, such as discourse.example.org

audiences: the members of any Discourse forum; discovery finds the topics, and discourse-forum, which reads them, says whom it reaches

terms.licence: Each forum sets its own licence for posts; the software sets none.

obtain.how: A topic's posts are readable as JSON from /t/<id>.json?include_raw=true, with the rest of a long topic from /t/<id>/posts.json by post id, 20 to a request, on a forum that lets visitors read without signing in. The software's own defaults (config/discourse_defaults.conf) allow 200 requests per minute and 50 per 10 seconds from one address; each forum may set its own, so the adapter keeps one request per 2 seconds. Discourse's default terms of service, which a forum may keep or replace, say "You may not automate access to the forum"; each capture plan entry quotes its forum's own terms.
